title: Assembly of exon junction complexes on spliceosomes begins before spliceosome activation.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: I opened the MassIVE repository page for accession MSV000101000 (MassIVE is a public mass-spectrometry data repository): it reports the dataset as PRIVATE, not yet released, and says metadata and files require logging in. I tried the supplementary files four times by two routes: the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint timed out three times (120 s each), and the PubMed Central supplement archive gkag803_supplemental_files.zip returned a 1,817-byte HTML block page, not a zip. I read the whole open-access full text (82,377 characters) including the data availability statement, methods and every mention of each supplementary table.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the contents of the data: that anti-EIF4A3, anti-RNPS1-2XHA and anti-CASC3 immunoprecipitations (pulling a protein down with an antibody) were done in triplicate with a rabbit IgG antibody as the negative control, in one cell line (HEK293T, a human kidney-derived line); that quantification used DIA-NN (a mass-spectrometry search tool) with the MaxLFQ label-free intensity algorithm at 1% false discovery rate; and that Supplementary Table S1 holds the IP-MS protein list, S2 the structurally resolved splicing factors, and S3-S7 only antibodies, oligonucleotides and primers. I never saw a single row or column of any of these.

a1_downloadable.note: FAIL, verified not by reading. The only named repository deposit (MassIVE MSV000101000) is marked private on its own dataset page and needs a login. The supplementary tables, the paper's other stated data source, could not be retrieved by any open route I tried (Europe PMC timed out; PubMed Central's supplement archive returned a block page).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: FAIL on the paper's own description. The paper's finding - which spliceosome assembly stage each factor joins at - is not a column anywhere. It is constructed by cross-referencing immunoprecipitation enrichment against published cryo-electron-microscopy structures of pre-B, B, Bact and C spliceosome complexes, plus western blots of nuclear fractions. That is exactly the 'label must be inferred across sources' failure.

a3_inputs_present.note: Protein identities are given as gene symbols and UniProt accessions (e.g. P36970 was text-mined from the article), so sequences are one standard lookup away. Not a blocker; noted from text only.

a4_units_stated.note: The methods state MaxLFQ label-free quantification intensities at 1% precursor and protein-group false discovery rate, so the quantity and its scale are defined. Read in the methods, not seen in a file.

a5_enough_rows.note: FAIL. The experiment is three bait proteins (EIF4A3, RNPS1, CASC3) plus one IgG control, each in triplicate, in a single cell line - roughly a dozen mass-spectrometry runs. Even counting every detected protein group as a row, the unit of analysis for any assembly-stage question is the bait-prey pair across three baits, which is two orders of magnitude under the ~1,500-row bar. Row count not verified because no file opened.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: <10 MB of supplementary tables if they were obtainable; the raw mass-spectrometry files in MassIVE would be tens of gigabytes and are off-limits by policy anyway.
a6_fits_laptop.note: Size is not the problem here.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Cannot be checked at all: no file was obtainable, so there is no download count to compare against the paper. Recorded as unverifiable rather than matching.

a8_label_provenance.note: FAIL by circularity. The assembly-stage assignment comes from published cryo-electron-microscopy structures from other papers, i.e. an external interpretation layered onto the enrichment values, so a model predicting stage from enrichment would be learning the authors' structural annotation, not a measurement made in this study.

honest_claim_h3: No honest claim is available: the dataset is three antibody pull-downs in one cell line with no outcome column, and its key conclusion is an interpretation drawn from other papers' structures rather than a measurement in these files.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a protein's pull-down enrichment to predict when it joins the spliceosome during messenger RNA splicing.
plain_idea.train_on: What the model would see per protein: its enrichment in anti-EIF4A3, anti-RNPS1 and anti-CASC3 pull-downs relative to a control antibody, plus its sequence. Number of examples: unknown, and at most a few hundred splicing-related proteins from three pull-downs.
plain_idea.predict: Which stage of spliceosome assembly (pre-B, B, Bact, B*, C) the protein is present at. The true answer is not measured here; it comes from published cryo-electron-microscopy structures of spliceosomes solved by other groups and matched to this protein list by hand.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: RNA-splicing biologists would like a cheap way to place a new factor in the assembly timeline without solving a structure; but as framed here the answer would just reproduce existing structural annotations, so almost nothing would be learned if it worked.

ml_idea: Considered and rejected: predict spliceosome assembly stage for a splicing factor from its co-immunoprecipitation enrichment with exon junction complex baits. Dies on three independent killers - the data is not obtainable, the stage label is not a column and must be inferred from other papers' structures, and the experiment has three baits where thousands of labelled examples are needed.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated for a modelling run, because no modelling task survives; the 0.01 GB working set is the expected size of the supplementary tables, inferred from the paper describing them as spreadsheet tables, not measured.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Open the MassIVE accession page - it says 'private' in one line, which kills A1 before any download is attempted. Second cheapest: count the baits (three), which kills A5.

verdict_reason: A small, careful molecular-biology study with no machine-learning substrate: the mass-spectrometry deposit MSV000101000 is still private and the supplementary tables could not be fetched (A1), the assembly-stage conclusion is inferred from other papers' cryo-electron-microscopy structures rather than being a column (A2 and A8), and the whole experiment is three bait pull-downs in one cell line (A5). Stopped at Part A as the checklist directs; no scores assigned.
